notes: Read all eight units, full COVID-19 coalition context, all ten candidates and the review. Restored COVID-19 relief and stimulus as the scope of all five principles, preserved the direct workers-and-communities versus executives contrast, and resolved mutual protection. Identified the United States in the People's Bailout coalition claim and COVID-19 in the capitalism characterization. Identified working-class power, removed the bright-future metaphor, split public ownership from green-job creation, and normalized the desired world. Restored the prediction that struggle continues beyond emergency relief and the Green Stimulus's future-landmark characterization.

claims.claim_text: The Five Principles of Just COVID-19 Relief and Stimulus make health the top priority for everyone without exception.
The Five Principles of Just COVID-19 Relief and Stimulus call for economic relief delivered directly to people.
The Five Principles of Just COVID-19 Relief and Stimulus call for rescuing workers and communities rather than corporate executives.
The Five Principles of Just COVID-19 Relief and Stimulus call for a down payment on a regenerative economy while preventing future crises.
The Five Principles of Just COVID-19 Relief and Stimulus call for protecting the democratic process while people protect one another.

Joining the People's Bailout would let DSA add an explicitly socialist voice to a multiracial working-class coalition building unity around a U.S. COVID-19 solution for the working-class majority rather than billionaires and the ruling class.
COVID-19 is characterized as a crisis of capitalism, whose fragility was exposed when a few weeks of lost profit sent it into a chaotic tailspin.
The fight is predicted to continue long after emergency COVID-19 relief is won.
The working class must build power immediately to advance the desired future.
The Green Stimulus would expand public ownership in transit agencies, local housing authorities, public-school districts and electric cooperatives.
The Green Stimulus would create millions of unionized green jobs.
The Green Stimulus is characterized as a crucial landmark in the desired future and a clear representation of a world with expanded public ownership and millions of unionized green jobs.
